extraction.Name: Josephine Larvie, formerly Terry Now Six Shooter
extraction.NOTES: Allottee states she never saw the land in her life and did not know what it was worth at the time of sale. She received some cash and the remainder by check. Her husband insisted she sign the deed. Purchaser Tackett gave her $30 a few days before the sale to hold the sale. She received $1530.00 total ($1500.00 for land plus $30.00 advance). She is not satisfied with the sale, stating she did not get enough money. Has six living children and four deceased children. Signed document as 'Josephine Terry Larvie Six Shooter.' Notary: Jas. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32. Subscribed and sworn to March 25, 1929.
